VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config.VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Descr: System configuration for the Drawing Editor mode. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by AppCore ConfigLoader and read back through ConfigLoader.GetSection('DrawingEditor'). Sheet sizes, frame slots, scale steps and titleblock rows all live here so no sheet dimension is ever hardcoded in a module.

VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Sheet.DefaultSheetSizeNote: A Vale lantern drawing is an A4 landscape sheet unless the views genuinely will not fit on one. This is the seed the sheet starts on; the auto layout ladder in the Scales block is what decides whether it stays there.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Sheet.BlockGapMmNote: Vertical gap between the view grid, the notes block and the titleblock. Screen sheet and PDF both honour this value.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Sheet.ScreenPixelsPerMmNote: Screen zoom only. Printed output is driven by the PDF exporter's target DPI, never by this value.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Sheet.SheetSizesNote: Dimensions are given landscape (long edge first). Portrait orientation swaps them at build time.

VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__ViewS.Label: 3D View
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__ViewS.ShowScaleNote: The 3D view is a perspective projection, so quoting a scale beside it would be misleading.

VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__ViewG.ResizeHandlesEnabledNote: Drag the gutters between frames to rebalance space. Scale is unchanged - a larger frame shows more of the model at the same 1:N.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__ViewG.ShowConstructionGridNote: The Env2d construction grid is a modelling aid for the editor viewport. A sheet frame is issued output, so the grid layer is cleared after each frame renders. The Lantern Editor viewport is unaffected.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__ViewG.GridNote: Slot ColumnStart / RowStart indices are one-based and must fit within Columns x Rows. ColumnSharesPct / RowSharesPct are session-overridable from gutter drags.

VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Sheet.SheetStyleNote: How everything printed on a sheet that is not a view is painted. Read by SheetChrome, which draws the on-screen sheet and the PDF export from one primitive list - so these values apply to both surfaces at once and there is nothing to keep in step by hand.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Sheet.FontFamilyNote: Helvetica leads because that is the face jsPDF embeds by reference. Arial is metrically identical and is what Windows substitutes, so the screen sets the same glyphs on the same advances as the PDF. Changing this to a face jsPDF does not carry will reintroduce the drift it was chosen to remove.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Sheet.CellPaddingMmNote: Text inset from the left and right edge of a boxed cell.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Sheet.TermsCellStyleNote: The terms cell has no styling of its own. It is the right-hand cell of the titleblock strip and prints on the TitleLabel and TitleValue sizes, weights, tracking and baselines defined above, which is what makes it read as part of the titleblock rather than as a box parked beside it. Its width, copy and QR settings live in Na__Terms__Config.json under VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBlock.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Sheet.TitleValueWeightNote: Regular, not bold. jsPDF's standard Helvetica only embeds regular and bold by reference - there is no semi-bold cut available without adding a separate embedded font file - so regular is the lighter of the two weights this titleblock can actually offer on both screen and PDF.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Sheet.TrackingNote: Letter spacing in millimetres, not ems, because a PDF content stream sets character spacing in the page unit. Both renderers add it after every glyph.

VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Scale.AvailableScaleDenominatorsNote: 1:5 and 1:25 were withdrawn. Neither is a scale a Vale lantern drawing is issued at - 1:5 puts a single bar across a sheet and 1:25 is not a scale rule anyone on the shop floor carries - and leaving them selectable meant a sheet could be sent out on one. 1:10 and 1:20 stay because they are legitimate hand picks for a detail sheet, but the auto layout never chooses them.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Scale.PreferredScaleDenominatorNote: The scale a Vale lantern drawing is issued at, and the floor the auto fit starts from. The fit never chooses anything FINER than this even when a small lantern would allow it - a tiny lantern drawn at 1:10 is a different document to every other drawing in the pack. Finer scales remain hand-selectable from the toolbar.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Scale.AutoFitLadderNote: Paper AND scale are chosen together, by walking this list in order and stopping at the first rung where every orthographic view fits its frame. Order is deliberate: keep 1:50 and grow the paper before giving up 1:50, because a drawing everyone can put a scale rule against matters more than the sheet it arrives on. The fourth rung is a backstop that should never be reached - a lantern that will not fit A4 at 1:100 is off the scale of anything Vale has built - and it exists only so the fallback is a small drawing rather than a clipped one.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Scale.AutoFitLadderRungNote: SheetSizeKey must name an entry in Sheet.SheetSizes and ScaleDenominator must appear in AvailableScaleDenominators. A rung failing either test is skipped with a console error rather than silently drawing the sheet at a scale its titleblock does not quote.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Scale.UniformScaleAcrossViewsNote: Vale drawings quote one scale for all orthographic views on a sheet, so the fit routine picks the coarsest scale that suits every view rather than fitting each frame independently.

VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Title.LogoCellWidthMmNote: Cell width is ~1.5x the previous logo column so the brand mark has breathing room without crowding the field strip.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Title.CompanyNameNote: Left blank - the Vale logo already carries the company identity, so a text line under it only wastes titleblock height.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Title.FieldPaddingNote: Screen CSS and PDF titleblock both read these millimetre paddings so the strip matches on paper.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Title.SingleRowLayoutNote: All fields sit on one horizontal strip. WidthMm values are relative flex shares, not absolute widths that would force wrapping.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Title.DateOrdinalSuffixScaleNote: The Date value is split into day / ordinal suffix / month-year at render time so the 'th' in '07th Aug 2026' can print small and raised, like real typeset ordinals. This is the suffix run's size as a fraction of FontSizeValueMm; the raise is derived from that so its top lines up with the day number's cap height.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Title.RowsNote: Row Key maps to a field the TitleBlockRenderer resolves from the project and lantern. WidthMm is a relative share of the strip. Element is omitted from the strip - it lives on the lantern schedule instead. An unresolved key still renders so the strip layout stays stable. The Scale value has the sheet size (from the solved layout's Page.Label) appended by SheetChrome at render time, so it reads 'Scale 1:50 @ A4' without a separate Paper Size row.

VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config.VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Annot: The sheet no longer carries a notes block. It printed three standing sentences about millimetres, figured dimensions and glazing, plus the project job notes. Those three sentences are now clauses in the project's terms document, and the sheet carries the terms callout in the bottom right instead - a QR code taking the reader to the full terms rather than a summary of three of them beside the views. Job notes are unaffected: they are still typed in the Specification tab and still print on the specification document under its ShowJobNotes toggle. The callout is configured in Na__Terms__Config.json under VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBlock.

VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__Toolb.ToolbarNote: The sheet live-updates on every geometry solve and every toolbar change, so there are no manual refresh or fit controls. ShowLanternSelector only paints when the project holds more than one lantern.

VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__PdfEx.FilenamePatternNote: Tokens: projectCode, projectName, drawingNumber, lanternTitle, revision, sheetSize, scale. Unresolved tokens collapse to nothing rather than printing literally.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__PdfEx.RasterPixelsPerMmNote: Roughly 610 dpi, doubled from 12 (305 dpi) because thin drafting linework was visibly soft on a printed sheet. jsPDF cannot place vector SVG, so orthographic views are rasterised at this density; raise for finer linework at the cost of file size. Views are written as PNG rather than JPEG - JPEG haloed thin dark lines - so file size grows roughly with the square of this number.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__PdfEx.SnapshotPixelsPerMmNote: Pixel density the 3D snapshot is rendered at, doubled alongside RasterPixelsPerMm so the perspective view does not read as the soft one on a sheet of otherwise crisp linework. The buffer is sized from the frame's paper millimetres at this density, which is what gives the snapshot the frame's exact aspect - the same image then fills the same rectangle on screen and on paper with no fitting between them. Falls back to RasterPixelsPerMm.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__PdfEx.SnapshotSupersampleNote: Env3d Snapshot.SupersampleFactor multiplies this again before the render is averaged back down, and SnapshotExporter clamps the product to a 36 megapixel budget. At A4 the doubled density still fits the full 2x supersample; on larger paper the clamp tapers the supersample rather than the output, so the image stays the requested size and loses only some edge smoothing.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__PdfEx.BlockGapMmNote: Legacy fallback. Prefer Sheet.BlockGapMm - both screen and PDF read Sheet first.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__PdfEx.PaintingNote: How a sheet is painted lives in SheetStyle and only there. This block used to carry a duplicate set of stroke widths and colours as a fallback, which meant a colour could be changed in the obvious place and silently overridden from here.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__PdfEx.Author: Vale Garden Houses Limited
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__PdfEx.Creator: Vale Lantern Designer
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__PdfEx.ScaleNote: The PDF page is created at the sheet's true millimetre size and each view's viewBox is rewritten to span exactly (frame size x scale denominator) model millimetres, so the file prints to scale at 100 percent with page scaling switched off.
VghLantern__DrawingEditor__Config__PdfEx.SharedRouteNote: These settings serve both export routes. The Drawing Editor's Download PDF and the drawing page inside a Preview and Send document are the same page, built by SheetPdfPainter and written by VghLantern__PdfWriter__Document.
